prompt: What is Microsoft Copilot in Microsoft 365 and how do you use it?
completion:
## Microsoft Copilot in Microsoft 365 **Copilot** is Microsoft’s generative‑AI assistant that lives inside the Microsoft 365 (M365) apps you already use—Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and more. Built on GPT‑4‑style models and tightly integrated with your Microsoft data (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Exchange, etc.), Copilot can: | What it does | Example tasks | |--------------|---------------| | Draft & edit text | “Write a quarterly update email” | | Summarise long content | “Give me a 3‑sentence summary of this article” | | Generate new content | “Create a 10‑slide presentation on climate change” | | Analyse data | “Show me the top‑performing products in 2024” | | Automate repetitive actions | “Create a PivotTable of sales by region” | | Create visuals | “Add a chart that visualises the revenue trend” | | Plan meetings | “Pull key discussion points from the last Teams call” | --- ## Getting Started | Step | What to do | Where to find it | |------|------------|-----------------| | **1. Confirm you have the right license** | Copilot is available to Microsoft 365 Business Premium, Microsoft 365 E3/E5, and Microsoft 365 E3/E5 with the Copilot add‑on. | Check in your admin portal or ask your IT admin. | | **2. Admin enablement (if you’re an admin)** | Turn on Copilot for your organization. | **Microsoft 365 admin center → Settings → Microsoft 365 services → Copilot** → toggle “Enable for all users”. | | **3. Open a supported app** | Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, or the new Copilot‑enabled “Copilot Studio” (when available). | Launch the app as usual. | | **4. Launch Copilot** | • In most apps a **Copilot** button appears in the toolbar or the “Insert” ribbon.
• In Word/PowerPoint/Excel the Copilot panel opens on the right.
• In Outlook you’ll see a Copilot icon next to the message composer. | Click the icon. | | **5. Give it a prompt** | Type what you want the AI to do. The prompt can be a single sentence, a paragraph, or a selection of text you’ve highlighted. | In the Copilot panel type or paste your prompt. | | **6. Review and refine** | Copilot returns a draft or a set of suggestions. Edit as needed. You can ask it to “Rewrite that in a more formal tone”, “Add a visual”, etc. | Click the output, then use “Edit”, “Re‑prompt”, or the “Refine” buttons. | | **7. Save / Export** | Once you’re happy, insert the final output into your document, slide deck, email, or spreadsheet. | Press **Insert** or simply copy‑paste into your workspace. | --- ## Quick‑Start Examples | App | Prompt | How Copilot Helps | |-----|--------|-------------------| | **Word** | “Draft a project proposal for launching a new SaaS product” | Generates a structured proposal (introduction, objectives, timeline, budget). | | **Excel** | “Show me a chart that compares quarterly sales across regions” | Builds the chart and adds the data series automatically. | | **PowerPoint** | “Create a 5‑slide deck about the benefits of cloud migration” | Generates slide titles, bullet points, and design suggestions. | | **Outlook** | “Summarise this email thread in two sentences” | Gives a concise recap you can paste into a reply. | | **Teams** | “What were the action items from last week’s meeting?” | Pulls the meeting transcript, highlights key actions, and formats them into a list. | --- ## Tips for Best Results | Tip | Why it works | |-----|--------------| | **Use specific prompts** | “Write a 150‑word thank‑you note for a client” is clearer than “write something nice.” | | **Highlight text** | Selecting a paragraph and asking Copilot to “rewrite for clarity” uses the context directly. | | **Iterate** | If the first output isn’t perfect, ask for a revision: “Make that more concise.” | | **Combine with other M365 features** | Pair Copilot with **Power Automate** or **SharePoint** to trigger workflows from AI‑generated content. | | **Check facts** | AI can hallucinate. Verify data points, especially for business or legal documents. | | **Use templates** | Copilot can pull from company templates stored in SharePoint—just mention “use the company‑brand template.” | --- ## Data & Privacy - All Copilot interactions stay within your Microsoft 365 tenant. - The AI model is hosted in Azure, and your data is not shared with external parties. - For regulated industries, check your organization’s data‑handling policy before using Copilot on sensitive material. --- ## Where to Learn More - **Microsoft 365 Copilot Docs** – the official docs cover feature‑by‑feature usage and admin settings. - **Microsoft Learn: Copilot in Microsoft 365** – hands‑on labs. - **Office Insider Community** – share prompts and tricks. --- ### Bottom Line Microsoft Copilot is a built‑in, AI‑powered assistant that turns natural‑language prompts into high‑quality drafts, insights, and visuals across all the core Office apps. Once enabled, it’s just a few clicks (or a sentence) away from boosting your productivity—whether you’re writing an email, analysing data, or presenting to executives. Give it a try today and see how it can transform the way you work!
